entries.columnsContract: `escalation_receipt_id PK, selection_receipt_id FK, scope_set_digest, actor_id, confirmed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(selection_receipt_id)`；只在high-volume时生成且必须来自独立第二次操作

entries.columnsContract: `batch_id PK, review_id FK, selection_receipt_id FK, escalation_receipt_id, scope_set_digest, actor_id, authorized_at_ms`
`authorization_id PK, destruction_scope_id FK, scope_digest, actor_id, batch_id FK, authorized_at_ms, state(active|stale|consumed)`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(destruction_scope_id,scope_digest)`；授权后不可取消或改Scope；Scope变化只允许旧Authorization进入stale，不存在revoked语义

entries.columnsContract: `offdeck_case_id PK, initial_authorization_id FK, current_authorization_id FK, shelf_entry_id FK, origin_kind, origin_ref, state(executing|blocked|awaiting_reauthorization|completed), recovery_revision, retry_at_ms NULL, blocked_reason NULL, created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(initial_authorization_id)`；只在首次Authorization事务中创建；环境暂不可达时以CAS写入blocked原因、下一次有界恢复时间并增加`recovery_revision`，恢复时使用同一Case和Authorization签发新的immutable Work；Scope失效后同一Case通过新的current Authorization恢复，不创建第二个Case；Direct Intent不要求Candidate

entries.columnsContract: `destruction_scope_id FK, material_key, effect_id, result(deleted|authorized_identity_already_absent|retained_due_to_active_reference), reality_digest, reference_release_result_digest NULL, completed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(destruction_scope_id,material_key)`；append-only completion evidence；Primary只允许deleted或精确absence，Related可在仍有active reference时保留

entries.columnsContract: `receipt_id PK, offdeck_case_id FK, shelf_entry_id FK, terminal_deck_fact_revision, released_control_set_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(offdeck_case_id)`；与Deck Fact terminal和Control release同事务成立

entries.columnsContract: `deregistration_id PK, shelf_id FK, state(active|committed), phase(waiting_responsibility|freezing_manifest|verifying|ready_to_commit|attention_required|completed), manifest_revision NULL, release_manifest_digest NULL, control_revision_set_digest NULL, entry_count, member_count, page_count, blocking_reason NULL, created_at_ms, committed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(shelf_id)`；Manifest列在Intent Admission时为NULL/0，freeze后以CAS整体更新；每个Shelf最多一个Deregistration；Supporting Work通过Foundation反向关联；不得引用Deletion Capability

entries.columnsContract: `deregistration_id FK, manifest_revision, member_ordinal, page_ordinal, page_member_ordinal, shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, inventory_member_ordinal, member_kind(controlled_material|reference_evidence), material_key, physical_identity_schema_ref, physical_identity_json, physical_identity_digest, reference_evidence_digest NULL, control_revision NULL, control_projection_digest NULL, member_digest, release_result NULL, committed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(deregistration_id,manifest_revision,member_ordinal)`；每页最多100项；identity JSON上限`4 KiB`；terminal commit只写controlled_material的release_result/committed_at_ms，旧revision仍作为历史成员清单保留；reference_evidence的Control列和release_result必须为NULL

entries.columnsContract: `receipt_id PK, deregistration_id FK, shelf_id FK, released_control_set_digest, terminal_fact_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(deregistration_id)`；与Shelf administrative terminal commit同事务成立

entries.columnsContract: `witness_id PK, on_deck_run_id, work_id, event_id, event_attempt_id, effect_id, target_commit_slot_id, decision_digest, member_key, kind(stage_member|target_directory), state(intent|created|copied|linked), revision, witness_schema_ref, witness_json, witness_digest, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(event_id,member_key)`、`INDEX(effect_id,state)`；仅首次JAV single短标题On-deck，Arca持有逐成员或目标目录的有界物理进度；JSON为closed witness≤64 KiB，按原Event/Attempt/Effect、Slot、Decision和源成员围栏CAS推进；不建立Control、收藏或Foundation反向外键。

entries.columnsContract: `perception_source_id PK, source_kind, integration_id, status, config_revision, current_cursor_revision NULL, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `current_cursor_revision IS NULL`表示尚无cursor row；`FOREIGN KEY(perception_source_id,current_cursor_revision) REFERENCES perception_source_cursors(perception_source_id,revision)`，SQLite以NULL跳过尚不存在的optional pointer校验；`INDEX(status,source_kind,perception_source_id)`；Integration ID为opaque platform reference

entries.columnsContract: `perception_acquisition_id PK, perception_source_id FK, source_config_revision, scope_schema_ref, scope_json, scope_digest, initial_cursor_revision, initial_cursor_value, state(active|completed|failed), created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: 一次Acquisition只属于一个Source/config revision；Scope JSON上限`16 KiB`；`UNIQUE(perception_source_id) WHERE state='active'`；`initial_cursor_revision=0`只是“创建时不存在cursor row”的逻辑CAS sentinel，不是FK pointer；Process历史不覆盖

entries.columnsContract: `intent_id PK, perception_acquisition_id FK, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, scope_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: 用户主动继续同一Acquisition的immutable Intent；`UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`；`INDEX(perception_acquisition_id,intent_id)`；只对active且当前Source/config相同的Douban采集签发；重放先于current-state校验；存在Intent后该Acquisition按normal准入，Scope内原始executionOrigin不变
